The '''electromagnetic plasma cannon''' was a [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] utilized by the [[Umbaran militia]] on its [[Umbaran mobile heavy cannon/Legends|mobile heavy cannon]], [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|hover tank]], and [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. They were noted for their power and destruction. A notable example of the sheer might of these cannons was when a few [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] used them to blast open the [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] of the [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]].
